literature.title: Can aura migraine be elicited by isolated pulmonary arteriovenous fistula?-A case report.
literature.abstract: A pulmonary arteriovenous fistula (PAVM) is an abnormal blood vessel that creates a direct connection between a pulmonary artery and its tributary vein bypassing capillary filter, establishing as a consequence of a low-resistance right-to-left shunting (RLS). The vast majority of PAVMs are congenital appearing more often in females than in males. A great number of patients with PAVMs is suffering concurrently from hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT) whose incidence is around 1 in 5,000.

literature.abstract: Hypothalamic lesions, such as tumors and demyelinating diseases, reportedly cause abnormal sleepiness. However, stroke involving the hypothalamus has rarely been described. Here, we report a patient with infarction restricted to the hypothalamus who presented with sudden onset of sleep.

literature.title: Intense migraines secondary to percutaneous closure of atrial septal defects.
literature.abstract: In this study we evaluated the development of migraine after percutaneous closure of atrial septal defect. An abrupt and excruciating form of migraine developed shortly after shunt closure in 5 of 13 consecutive patients undergoing this procedure. A dramatic relief of pain was achieved almost instantaneously after administration of 300 mg of clopidogrel.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 腦幹先兆型偏頭痛（原稱基底型偏頭痛）與後循環微栓子、PFO 相關性高於一般偏頭痛。Clopidogrel 抑制血小板栓子形成，可減少後循環微栓子負荷，阻斷腦幹先兆觸發機制。文獻（PMID 16103551, 30478066, 24770421）均集中於 PFO/RLS 合併有先兆偏頭痛之亞群，與腦幹先兆型偏頭痛病理生理學高度吻合。然而目前無針對「migraine with brainstem aura」之專屬臨床試驗，多數研究以「migraine with aura + PFO」為納入標準。

Therapeutic options to prevent stroke recurrence include antiplatelet drugs, oral anticoagulants, and transcatheter closure of the foramen. However, there are no published studies showing convincingly the superiority of any one of these strategies in preventing stroke recurrence.

clinical_trials.title: Quality Improvement and Practice Based Research in Neurology Using the Electronic Medical Record
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The investigators will conduct at NorthShore University HealthSystem pragmatic trials using the EMR for 10 common neurological disorders. They will demonstrate the feasibility of subgroup based adaptive assignment of treatments, electronic consenting, and outcomes data capture at the point of care using the EMR. They will identify the most effective treatments for common neurological disorders and seek replication by the NPBRN.

literature.title: P2Y12 receptor mediates microglial activation via RhoA/ROCK pathway in the trigeminal nucleus caudalis in a mouse model of chronic migraine.
literature.abstract: Microglial activation contributes to the development of chronic migraine (CM). The P2Y12 receptor (P2Y12R), a metabolic purinoceptor that is expressed on microglia in the central nervous system (CNS), has been indicated to play a critical role in the pathogenesis of chronic pain. However, whether it contributes to the mechanism of CM remains unknown. Thus, the present study investigated the precise details of microglial P2Y12R involvement in CM.

literature.title: Reduction in Osteoarthritis Risk After Treatment With Ticagrelor Compared to Clopidogrel: A Propensity Score-Matching Analysis.
literature.abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a common cause of joint pain and disability, and effective treatments are lacking. Extracellular adenosine has antiinflammatory effects and can prevent and treat OA in animal models. Ticagrelor and clopidogrel are both used in patients with coronary artery disease, but only ticagrelor increases extracellular adenosine levels. This study was undertaken to determine whether treatment with ticagrelor was associated with a lower risk of OA.

This study aims to explore diacerein's influence in inhibiting both viral replication and the inflammatory response after SARS-CoV-2 infection.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: P2Y12 受體在滑膜細胞（synoviocytes）及破骨細胞前驅細胞上有功能性表達（PMID 34840926），核苷酸信號調節滑膜細胞增殖及破骨細胞分化，提供間接理論基礎。然而，關鍵不良信號：PMID 38107217（2023）記錄「Clopidogrel-Associated Inflammatory Arthritis」個案，顯示 Clopidogrel 本身可誘發炎症性關節炎，為重大安全性警訊。20 篇文獻中大多數（>15篇）討論 tofacitinib vs TNF 抑制劑比較，Clopidogrel 僅以共病用藥或不良事件角色出現，無治療性使用證據。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 「OA 易感性」為遺傳/風險因子研究範疇，而非直接治療適應症。唯一文獻（PMID 20435227）為個人基因組臨床評估案例報告，提及 Clopidogrel 相關 CYP2C19 基因型，與 OA 易感性無直接關聯。此適應症分類可能為 TxGNN 知識圖譜本體論擴散（ontology propagation）產物，不具獨立臨床意義。
假性軟骨發育不全症（pseudoachondroplasia）為 COMP 基因突變導致之遺傳性骨骼發育不全症，屬單基因遺傳病，病理機制為 COMP 蛋白異常折疊及 ER stress，與血小板聚集/P2Y12 信號路徑無任何已知關聯。TxGNN 預測可能源於骨關節疾病節點間的知識圖譜路徑擴散，無臨床意義。文獻及試驗數量均為零。
纖維肌痛症之核心機制為中樞敏感化（central sensitization）及下行疼痛調節失常，非周邊血小板或血管機制主導。雖然部分研究顯示纖維肌痛患者有血小板功能異常（過度激活），理論上 P2Y12 拮抗劑可能改善此現象，但此假說尚未進入任何臨床研究階段。文獻及試驗數量均為零，TxGNN 高分為純計算預測，無任何臨床佐證。
